contract.note: The functional-versus-robustness reading is ordinary and fair. April supplies a reasonable contemporary snapshot; security measures one relevant dimension without establishing comprehensive robustness.

evidence.note: The April company disclosure reports paired functional and security scores of 84.4% and 7.8% for one configuration. This supports the qualitative gap, subject to the vendor's commercial interests and lack of independent replication.
Correctly presented as March research about iterative code quality. It supplies background, not an April outcome.

reviews.rationale: The dated April benchmark supports substantial functional success alongside materially weaker security performance. This is limited support from vendor-run research, not an independently replicated production-wide finding. Feedback-assisted repair does not negate the comparison, and no causal conclusion about the training objective follows.
